svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Component · PicPlace status · working-copy · narrow
svg.desc: Mirrors PicPlaceStatusCard (App/PicPlace/PicPlaceViews.swift) in its .previewOnly state with the project's working copy here, on the Mac Gallery item inspector (picture tiers stage 5, 2026-10-04; docs/picture-tiers-plan.md §15 — the phone card is picplace-status.working-copy.phone.svg). The green photo.fill (#248A3D: here; StatusGlyph.Asset.workingCopy) in the glyph column, the title "Working copy here", the caption "The originals are on PicPlace · 1 file · 2,9 MB", the action "Download originals"; then the Working copy line as one row — "Working copy · Here · 1,3 MB · text, masks, shapes and crop work on it" (the detail wraps to the second line in the real pane; drawn as one here, trimmed) with Remove… trailing (HeavyLine.Action.removeWorkingCopy, no server check; after it the card is preview-only). Measured from the 2026-10-04 bench's window capture of the item view (M3-level).
